output.summary: A genus of flowering shrubs predominantly native to temperate parts of the Northern Hemisphere. Members vary in their leaves, flowers and fruit: some have thorns, and their many-seeded berries include currants and gooseberries. Several species are cultivated for edible fruit, while the genus is also the main alternate host of white pine blister rust.
output.edibilityNote: Several species have edible fruit, including blackcurrants, redcurrants, white currants and European gooseberries.
